name: Ubuntu + uv - ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get upgrade -y
postCreateCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv python install 3.12 && ([ -f pyproject.toml ] || uv init --name "$(basename $PWD | tr 'A-Z_ ' 'a-z--')") && uv add polars pandas && uv add --dev ruff ipykernel
postStartCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get upgrade -y
